source.title: North Carolina Driver Handbook
source.publisher: North Carolina Division of Motor Vehicles
source.pagination: PDF pages 3–107 correspond to printed pages 1–105. PDF pages 1–2 are the front cover and blank inside cover; PDF page 108 is the back cover.
source.extraction: pdftotext -layout, followed by page-by-page factual paraphrase and direct visual inspection of relevant tables and figures. The Markdown is an informational extraction, not a verbatim transcription.
source.editionNote: The printed revision and PDF metadata dates differ. Metadata dates are not treated as a new edition. This record identifies the bytes retrieved from the official URL, not an assurance that every statement in the handbook reflects current law.

scope: Every concept summary and source citation
Every question stem and keyed choice
All four choices and feedback explanations per question
Relevant handbook figures and all 22 bundled sign illustrations
